spec.description: Show a destination, activity, stay idea, or itinerary as a persistent travel card. Use general travel knowledge and visitor preferences. This presents a suggestion, not live search results or a booking. Call at most three times per response. Label any budget as an estimate with currency and basis; use empty strings when unknown.

highlights.description: Keep ordinary cards to about six highlights. Itineraries may include one entry per day, up to 30.

timing.description: Suggested duration or season; empty if unknown

budget.description: Rough estimate including currency and per-person/per-night/total basis, or empty if unknown. Never a live quote.

bare.alwaysSetResult: Travel suggestion card displayed. No reservation or purchase was made.
